subject: next: the waitlist
body:
site's live and people are noticing. my uncle sent it to his golf group.

next up, a waitlist:

- a Waitlist page with an email field and a Join button, linked from the homepage.
- a counter of how many people are on it. start it at 10,000. social proof.
- every sign-up gets a confirmation email with their place in line.

demand is real. we just need somewhere to put it.

logan
